parsed.rationale: All three records are `type-alias-object` declarations in the `Wallpaper` package with empty `fields_or_signature` lists. The structural signal of `shared_field_count: 2` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` indicates the pipeline matched them purely on the shape of being empty-bodied type aliases, not on any shared semantic content. `PlaybackButtonControls`, `ThemeDebugOverlay`, and `WallpaperView` are clearly distinct domain concepts (a playback control surface, a debug overlay, and a wallpaper view respectively) whose structural coincidence is an artifact of all being type aliases with no fields, not evidence of duplicated logic. No consolidation is warranted because there is nothing to consolidate — each alias names a different concept and any attempt to unify them would destroy the semantic distinctions the names encode.
